traits.name: Aggressive.
traits.text: As a bonus action, the orog can move up to its speed toward a hostile creature it can see.

actions.name: Greatsword.
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, or 11 (2d8 + 3) if used with two hands.

actions.name: Javelin.
actions.text: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6 + 1) piercing damage.
